channel.title: Fin Planning Pod
channel.description: Every day, Riya and Alex open up one real Indian money story from the Fin Planning Pod video library, rupee by rupee: income, spending, investments, and portfolio, in four to five minutes.

channel.itunes:summary: Every day, Riya and Alex open up one real Indian money story from the Fin Planning Pod video library, rupee by rupee: income, spending, investments, and portfolio, in four to five minutes.

item.title: Fin Planning Pod Ep 13 — The Five Income Stream Plan
item.description: Shashank Udupa, a 33-year-old Bangalore entrepreneur and finance creator, went from a 50,000 rupee monthly salary in 2016 to about 13 lakh rupees a month across five income sources, spends 8.62 lakh a month including 5 lakh of team salaries, and tracks a 5.47 crore net worth split between 3.15 crore of real estate and about 3 crore of equities.

item.title: Fin Planning Pod Ep 12 — The 80 Lakh Bangalore CA Plan
item.description: Rishabh, a Bangalore chartered accountant who works with startups, earns 79.92 lakh rupees a year, takes home 5.40 lakh a month, spends 2.80 lakh a month with travel as his biggest bonus line, invests just 40,000 rupees monthly with zero mutual fund SIPs, and built a 1.76 crore portfolio aimed at a five year freedom runway.

item.title: Fin Planning Pod Ep 11 — The 1.27 Crore Pune Trader Plan
item.description: Sahil Ramitra, a professional futures trader in Pune, earns 1.27 crore rupees a year, takes home 8.11 lakh a month, sends 5 lakh a month to family as interest and provident fund funding, invests 1.12 lakh monthly, and built a 25 crore portfolio anchored by 12.5 crore of real estate.

item.title: Fin Planning Pod Ep 10 — The 41.6 Lakh Bangalore Plan
item.description: Pavit, a Bangalore data and AI specialist, earns 41.6 lakh rupees a year, takes home 2.19 lakh a month, invests 92,000 rupees monthly, and grew his SIP from 3,000 rupees in 2018 to 75,000 while building an 80.75 lakh portfolio with his wife through a joint account.

item.title: Fin Planning Pod Ep 9 — The 87 Lakh Ayodhya Plan
item.description: Vishnu Mishra, a 32-year-old freelance software engineer in Ayodhya working for US clients, earns 87 lakh rupees a year, takes home 5.22 lakh a month, invests 1.12 lakh, and built a 4.31 crore portfolio anchored by Ayodhya real estate.

item.title: Fin Planning Pod Ep 8 — The 79 Lakh Hyderabad Plan
item.description: Aditya Jain, a Hyderabad product manager from Meerut, splits his 3.93 lakh monthly take-home almost in half: 1.96 lakh spent with intention (including 30,000 a month on travel), 1.5 lakh invested, and a 1.24 crore portfolio.

item.title: Fin Planning Pod Ep 7 — The 58 Lakh Tier 2 City Plan
item.description: A tier 2 city software professional on a 58 lakh package takes home 2.91 lakh a month, sends 40,000 rupees to his parents, and invests 1.97 lakh every month into a 73.8 lakh portfolio.

item.title: Fin Planning Pod Ep 6 — The 1.95 Crore Nomad Plan
item.description: Seth, a 26-year-old digital nomad from Indore, earns 1.95 crore rupees a year from his marketing agency, invests 7,64,416 rupees every month, and built a 1.6 crore portfolio while travelling through Asia.

item.title: Fin Planning Pod Ep 5 — The 38 Lakh Maharashtra Plan
item.description: A contractual software developer in Maharashtra earns 38 lakh rupees a year, invests 1,00,300 rupees every month through an ETF Lego strategy, and protects his young family with six insurance policies.

item.title: Fin Planning Pod Ep 4 — The 93 Lakh Gurgaon Plan
item.description: Damas Varsi, a senior manager in software engineering in Gurgaon, earns 93 lakh rupees a year, invests 2,36,000 rupees every month, and built a 9.22 crore net worth after starting at 25,000 rupees a month.

item.title: Fin Planning Pod Ep 3 — The 77 Lakh Bangalore Plan
item.description: Ganesh Sharma, a software development engineer in Bangalore, earns 77 lakh rupees, invests 2,28,000 rupees every month, and built a 1.005 crore portfolio while spending 80 lakh rupees on family setup costs.

item.title: Fin Planning Pod Ep 2 — The 41.6 Lakh Bangalore Plan
item.description: Pavit, a data and AI specialist in Bangalore, earns 41.6 lakh rupees, invests 92,000 rupees every month, and stepped his SIP up from 3,000 rupees in 2018 to 75,000 rupees while building an 80.75 lakh portfolio.

item.title: Fin Planning Pod Ep 1 — The 82 Lakh Warangal Plan
item.description: Jitender from Warangal earns 82.8 lakh rupees from salary, freelancing, and rent, invests 1.88 lakh every month, and built a 2.05 crore portfolio from a 6,000 rupee first salary.
